### **2. DETAILED SCOPE OF WORK**

#### **Phase 1: Tear-Off & Demolition**
* Strip and dispose of one (1) layer of existing asphalt shingles down to the bare wooden decking.
* Inspect underlying roof decking (plywood/OSB) for rot or structural defect. *(Note: Decking replacement, if needed, will be billed at $85 per 4'x8' sheet upon client approval).*

#### **Phase 2: Substrate & Waterproofing Preparation**
* **Valleys:** Install self-adhering, high-temperature Ice & Water Shield barrier along all valley lines to prevent ice-dam and wind-driven rain penetration.
* **Deck Underlayment:** Install premium High-Temp Synthetic Underlayment across 100% of the remaining roof deck, meeting NC Building Code standards for high-temp metal roof assemblies.

#### **Phase 3: Metal Roofing System Installation**
* Supply and custom-fit **26-Gauge Galvalume Standing Seam Metal Panels** (Concealed Fastener System).
* Install factory-bent eaves drip edge, rake trim, sidewall, and ridge cap to match panel profile and finish.

#### **Phase 4: Flashing & Penetrations**
* **Chimney Flashing:** Custom-fabricate and install a full Galvalume metal apron, step-flashing, and counter-flashing around the chimney masonry, sealed with high-grade polyurethane sealant.

#### **Phase 5: Site Cleanup & Final Inspection**
* Magnetic sweep of the entire yard, driveway, and landscaping beds to recover nails and metal shavings.
* Complete removal and haul-off of all job-related debris.
* Final quality audit with the client and municipal code inspection.

codes:
======================================================================
NORTH CAROLINA RESIDENTIAL CODE (NCRC) - ROOF ASSEMBLY COMPLIANCE
======================================================================

[+] AHJ JURISDICTION: Buncombe County Permitting & Inspections
    - Building Permit: REQUIRED for structural re-roofing / material transition.
    - Decking Inspection: Mandatory prior to underlayment application.

[+] TECHNICAL CODE REQUIREMENTS:
    - Wind Resistance (NCRC R905.10): Fasteners must withstand local design wind
      speeds (115 mph baseline in western NC).
    - Underlayment (NCRC R905.1.1): Self-adhering polymer-modified bitumen sheet
      required at eaves and valleys (ice & water shield) where pitch <= 6/12.
    - Metal Panel Standard: Must comply with ASTM A792 (55% Al-Zn Galvalume).
